Response: Cannot hedge (vs large corps that can forward-contract)
Transmission_to_Consumer: Structural disadvantage vs large business creates accelerated small business closure rate relative to large chains
Notes: KEY CONCEPT: Tariff asymmetry is the fundamental mechanism. Large businesses hedge via futures, switch suppliers via scale relationships, and hold 6-12 month inventory buffers.
